name: Darkness Calls the Raven
source:
In the storm of the century, 1988, you encounter a strange man at your family diner. You know little about him – who he is, what he does, or where he came from.

Soon, an unwelcome break in your Saturday routine draws you closer to him, whether you like it or not.

Yet in the forgotten woods of California, the storm is only the beginning. The latest reports may cast a greater shadow than the thunderclouds above. Whether you pursue these reports, uncover the truth about who he really is, or stumble upon the little secrets I’ve programmed in, the choice is yours.

In the end, you must decide what frightens you more: discovering the truth behind the reports, or falling for someone you were never meant to trust.

[From [url=https://raven-nights.itch.io/darkness-calls-the-raven-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
